name: Evogliptin

examples.title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of DA-1229 (Evogliptin) in Patient's Calcific Aortic Valve Disease With Mild to Moderate Aortic…
examples.why: The study is terminated due to sponsor's business decision. There were no safety issues influencing this course of action.

summary: Evogliptin received a liver score of 45 and a heart score of 21, both falling in the low band [M]. These liver and heart results come from a small computer model rather than from tests conducted on people [M]. In addition, a human study involving patients with mild to moderate disease in a heart valve was stopped early because of a business decision, not because of any safety concerns [4].
